abilities.name: Dough-Fu
_curatorNotes: N3 has two hitmarks [11, 18] and N4 has four hitmarks [5, 15, 24, 29]; cancel frames sourced from last hitmark per recipe. N5 gcsim sets C=500 with comment 'this action is illegal' — omitted. High plunge exists in gcsim (swap=63, N=58, E=60, Q=60; no D/J set) but not represented (recipe uses lowPlungeFrames only). gcsim restricts LowPlungeAttack to AirborneXianyun context — plunge returns error unless launched by Xianyun E; reviewer may want to add a plunge caveat.

abilities.name: Guoba Attack
abilities.description: Summons Guoba, who will continuously breathe fire at opponents, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.

abilities.name: Pyronado
abilities.description:
Displaying her mastery over both fire and polearms, Xiangling sends a Pyronado whirling around her.
The Pyronado will move with your character for the ability's duration, dealing Pyro DMG to all opponents in its path.

passives.name: Crossfire
passives.description: Increases the flame range of Guoba by 20%.

passives.name: Beware, It's Super Hot!
_curatorNotes: Effect not yet authored — needs reviewer pass. When Guoba's duration ends, the active character gains 10% ATK for 10s (the chili pepper pickup). Pickup timing is user-parameterized in gcsim via a4_delay param (delay after Guoba expiry). Probable trigger: afterDuration on skill summon (after Guoba expires). Target: active character. gcsim: c.a4(guoba.Duration + a4Delay) queued relative to Guoba expiry in skill.go; applies ATKP +0.10 to active char for 600 frames.
passives.description: When Guoba Attack's effect ends, Guoba leaves a chili pepper on the spot where it disappeared. Picking up a chili pepper increases ATK by 10% for 10s.

constellations.name: Crispy Outside, Tender Inside

_curatorNotes: Inherited `manual` trigger — do not rewrite. Probable trigger: onHit, fires when Guoba's breath hits an enemy (ability context: skill). No ICD visible in gcsim — each Guoba tick can trigger independently. Target: enemy, reduces Pyro RES by 15% for 6s. gcsim: c1 is an AttackCBFunc passed to QueueAttackWithSnap in guoba.go; adds ResistMod on the hit enemy via e.AddResistMod.

constellations.description: Opponents hit by Guoba's attacks have their Pyro RES reduced by 15% for 6s.

constellations.name: Oil Meets Fire

_curatorNotes: Inherited `manual` trigger — do not rewrite. Probable trigger: onHit with ability: 'normal', fires only on the last hit of the normal combo (N5, NormalCounter == 4). Applies 2s 'Implode' debuff on enemy, then detonates for 75% ATK AoE Pyro DMG after 120f (2s). gcsim: c.c2(done) returns AttackCBFunc registered to the N5 attack; if target not already debuffed, queues c2Explode at 120f and adds c2Debuff status (120f). done flag prevents re-trigger on multi-hit N5.

constellations.description: The last attack in a Normal Attack sequence applies the Implode status onto the opponent for 2s. An explosion will occur once this duration ends, dealing 75% of Xiangling's ATK as AoE Pyro DMG.

constellations.name: Condensed Pyronado

_curatorNotes: Inherited `manual` trigger — do not rewrite. Probable trigger: onCast with ability: 'burst'; buff applied at frame 56 of burst animation when Pyronado activates (via QueueCharTask at a=56 in burst.go). Duration tied to Pyronado's active window (10s base, 14s at C4). Target: all party members. gcsim: c.c6(maxDuration) calls AddStatMod with NewBaseWithHitlag on all chars for PyroP +0.15.
